title: Say Boses na Inkapekder
intro: Sayan indibidual et nanonotan lapud aralem a kakabatan tan panangigiya, ya mangiiter na simbawa ya onlampas ed saray kailalakan. Saray salita ra et paneknek ed inka-dios tan say kaimportantian na pamidbir ed saray bendisyon tan subok manlapud Dios. Amtaen so pakabidbiran na sayan gagalangen a kamarerwa.
clues: Aliwan propeta ak, balet say kakabatan ko et nisulat ed Madibinon Kasulatan.
Say simbawa ko ed anak ko et indanet toy pisasalamat ed si Allah tan say pangipaliis ed shirk.
Imbangat ko so nipaakar ed kaimportantian na pikakasi, pangiganggan ed maong, tan pangisebel ed mauges.
Pinasakbayan ko sumpad inkatangsit tan panakar ya anggapoy inka-insulto ed dalin.
Say ngaran ko et niiter ed sakey ya interon kapitulo na Quran, ya mangipapabitar ed saray bangat ko.
Say simbawak et kaiba so anos ed kairapan, ta diad tua, satan so manlalapud sanka-determinadoan iran pamaakaran.

trial.label: Manunan Panagbangat/Pangigiya
options: Mangiter na kakabatan tan moral a simbawa
Pangidaulo ed sakey a bansa ed itatalona
trial.answer: Mangiter na kakabatan tan moral a simbawa

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Makabat a simbawa ed sakey ya ilalak
location.answer: Makabat a simbawa ed sakey ya ilalak

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say kakabatan to et nisulat ed Quran
Inwanwan to ray totoo to ed balon dalin
outcome.answer: Say kakabatan to et nisulat ed Quran

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
